description: Durable review outcomes for validated manifests that should not be promoted as parliamentary catalogue playback endpoints.

decisions.reason: Canal Gov is the Brazilian federal executive branch broadcaster, not a parliamentary service.
The endpoint uses cleartext HTTP and a bare IP address, so an HTTPS catalogue page cannot embed it safely. The official TVR Parlemen page is catalogued instead.
Radio Radicale is a third-party relay. The official Camera dei Deputati WebTV page is catalogued instead.
Privesc.eu is a third-party relay. The Parliament of Moldova official live page and YouTube channel are catalogued instead.
KTV is a national government policy broadcaster rather than the National Assembly's NATV parliamentary service.
The manifest contains a timestamped HouseLive event identifier and is not a stable reusable floor-stream endpoint. Stable official House and Senate watch pages are catalogued instead.
